simple.meaning: עָוֺן (ʻâvôn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “perversity , i.e. (moral) evil.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 232 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 4:13. Its contexts include family, family line, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָוֺן (H5771).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָוֺן (ʻâvôn) / H5771 is traced through Genesis 4:13, Genesis 15:16, Genesis 19:15, Genesis 44:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.
